summary:
This digital book explores the story of NASA’s Mars Pathfinder mission and its small rover, Sojourner. It introduces young space enthusiasts to the technology that was sent to Mars and later left behind after the mission ended.
Through clear explanations, illustrations, photographs, a timeline and a short quiz, the book makes space exploration easier and more exciting to understand.
The project connects directly to the challenge by showing that even equipment left behind can have a lasting scientific impact. Its discoveries helped us understand Mars better and continue to inspire future exploration.
details:
My project is an educational digital book about NASA’s Mars Pathfinder mission and its rover, Sojourner. It explains how the mission worked, how the rover explored Mars and what scientists learned from it. The book uses short texts, photographs, illustrations, a timeline and an interactive quiz to guide readers through the topic.

The main benefit is that it makes space exploration easier to understand, especially for younger readers. It shows that even equipment left behind on another planet can provide valuable scientific information long after a mission has ended.

The intended impact is to increase interest in space exploration and help people understand why past missions are still important for future discoveries.

The creative aspect is the combination of visual storytelling, scientific information and interactive elements. I considered the accuracy of the information, the clarity of the explanations and how to make the content interesting and accessible to a younger audience.
